visual_thesis: Faster task production can leave a workflow bottleneck; work must be reorganized around expertise and ownership.
mechanism_metaphor: One continuous overhead ink-map of a work system, no geographic scenery, no people, no map place names. A wide flow band for faster production narrows sharply at an Expert review bottleneck, then reaches a small customer-outcome aperture. Dashed and solid contour boundaries distinguish a narrow task role from broader Workflow ownership. The only causal arrow follows the actual output band from production port (360,300) to bottleneck entry (620,300). Do not draw an arrow that guarantees bottleneck removal or business gain. Below the main contour, shared-infrastructure strata connect by noncausal fine leaders to the workflow. A separate small evidence inscription names the interviewed customer sample. Use actual empty negative space to show the bottleneck, no invented rate, percentage, chart or staffing reduction. Labels should be open white-field annotations, never cream plaques. Detached limitation explicitly bars a causal productivity claim.
